proposed.opinion_calls: proposed in the proposal file: counsel is called (blocking) on any delegation or power given, used, widened, ratified or revoked; any request touching an exclusion; any text that promises something to a reader, customer, organiser or source; anything that would accept terms; personal data newly collected or shown; (advisory) take-down and rights requests, claims about the law, relaxations that change who may act for whom
